reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 6 points better, in a game of about 221 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 68 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 196 and 244 total points.
